bootstrap.note: historical evaluation uncertainty only; never MC sampling uncertainty

excluded_2025.role: never in gate population; secondary context only if discussed

exploratory_policy: findings beyond H1-H7 labelled EXPLORATORY, never preregistered

gate.COMPLEMENTARITY: PASS iff each mechanism strictly better (lower race-macro loss) in >=1 race AND both signs of per-row advantage present
gate.COVERAGE_ADEQUACY: PASS iff >=6 races with >=1 comparable state AND all 3 stages >=20 comparable rows AND >=150 comparable rows total AND no single race >40% of rows
gate.DISTINCT_SIGNAL: PASS iff >=1 state with leader mismatch AND >=1 row with |gap| outside Wilson 95% MC interval
gate.ROBUSTNESS: PASS iff race-macro and pooled mean spearman both in (0, 0.99) AND bootstrap CIs computable (n>=6 races)
gate.SEMANTIC_VALIDITY: PASS iff OOF fold map exact + state_id joins exact + P4/P5/P6/P10/P11 zero + no normalization + fold-through params used
gate.decision: FUSION_RESEARCH_WARRANTED iff all five PASS; BLOCKING_SEMANTIC_MISMATCH iff construction violates A/B/C contract; else FUSION_NOT_WARRANTED; no override

ground_truth.join_order: after alignment + metrics; never in B/C structures
ground_truth.source: OOF target columns (binary per driver-row); race winner = sole target==1 row (fail-closed otherwise)

hypotheses: H3 magnitude disagreement beyond MC sampling in some states
H5 complementary errors, no uniform domination
H6 V3.5 P_win little independent info
H7 XGB secondary diversity, superiority not assumed
independent_votes: Logistic and V3.5 P_win never counted as two votes (SHARED_OR_DERIVED_LINEAGE)

mc2_config.frame: replay timeline frame with state_time_s == d9 row state_time_s for (race, driver, lap)
mc2_config.prep: frozen _prepare_state_and_mechanisms (V3.2C presence + V3.2D mechanisms + conditioned variance)

population_rule.per_race: earliest lap (by lap_number) with full 20-driver OOF coverage in each stage third (EARLY/MID/LATE)
population_rule.races: 68 OOF races sorted by (season, round); every 8th starting index 2 -> 8 races
population_rule.rows: all 20 driver rows per selected (race, lap); MC2 executed per ROW at row-exact T; refusals recorded, never imputed

scoring.epsilon_policy: evaluation-only clipping of exact 0/1 native values; stored natives untouched; applied identically to all sources; repository precedent V3.5
scoring.loss_advantage: loss_logistic - loss_mc2; positive = MC2 lower loss
scoring.unit: driver-row binary WIN event; no race normalization of Logistic

secondary_pairs: V3.5 topk vs MC2 derived topk where exposed
v34: excluded; never evaluated as a source
